testsuite.name: helium314.keyboard.latin.InputLogicTest

testcase.name: autospace works in URL field when starting with quotes
autospace still happens after " if next word is in quotes
no intermediate commit in URL field without protocol and with URL detection
select whole thing except http(s) as composing word if URL detection enabled and selecting
double space results in period and space, and delete removes the period
no intermediate commit in URL field with protocol
no intermediate commit in URL field with protocol and URL detection
only protocol commit in text field with protocol and URL detection
select whole thing except http(s) as composing word if URL detection enabled and typing
intermediate commit in text field without protocol and with URL detection
autospace works in URL field when input isn't URL, also for multiple suggestions
don't accidentally detect some other text fields as URI
autospace works in URL field when input isn't URL
autospace still happens after " if nex word is in " and after comma
insertLetterIntoWordHangulFails
